modules.name: CAMT Update Manager
modules.description: CAMT Update Manager and Module Repository with Network Resilience: requests primary HTTPS, urllib fallback, retries, cache and atomic downloads.
modules.release_notes: Network Resilience: requests primary HTTPS, urllib fallback, three retry rounds, short back-off, cached valid update/catalog data, atomic .part downloads and user-friendly handling of temporary connection resets such as WinError 10054.

modules.name: CAMT Evidence Integrity
modules.description: Evidence hashing, integrity verification and chain-of-custody manifest workspace.
modules.release_notes: Evidence Integrity 1.0.1: verification states, current hash tracking and CSV manifest export.

modules.name: CAMT Log Timeline Explorer
modules.description: Generic log normalization, filtering, statistics and forensic timeline export.
modules.release_notes: Log Timeline Explorer 1.0.1: severity filtering and top-source statistics.

modules.name: CAMT NetMap Baseline Comparator
modules.description: Compare CAMT NetMap/topology snapshots and identify added, removed and changed assets.
modules.release_notes: NetMap Baseline Comparator 1.0.1: service/vulnerability delta detection and detailed JSON diff export.
